description: Find ranked models by (partial) name or provider. Returns rank, Aggregate Rating and the model page URL. One row per model by default, fused across reasoning-effort settings.

include_variants.description: Return each reasoning-effort variant separately (e.g. "Claude Opus 4.6 (High)") instead of one fused row per model. Default false.

query.description: Model or provider name fragment, e.g. "opus" or "deepseek".

name: search_models
title: Search models
